title: Adaptive Interventions for Emergency Department Patients With Opioid Use Disorder
official: Adaptive Interventions for Emergency Department Patients With Opioid Use Disorder
summary: The ADAPT-ED study is a two-stage, sequential multiple assignment randomized trial (SMART) to inform the development of an adaptive intervention that is optimally effective in increasing long-term buprenorphine use for adults presenting to the ED with probable opioid use disorder (OUD).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Presented for ED care at ARMC
* Age 18 or older
* Probable OUD diagnosis
* Speak and understand English or Spanish
* Have capacity to give informed consent
* Provide a signed and dated informed consent form
